values.note: 9 tent/RV sites with gravel roads and parking spurs: 5 reservable, 4 walk-up (marked W). No site lengths published.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234788 ('Here, we have 9 sites, 5 for reservations and 4 that are walk-up', 'Campground roads and parking spurs are gravel'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: No water: bring your own. No trash collection; pack out garbage.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234788 ('There is no water at this campground. Please bring your own drinking water. An accessible vault toilet is provided.', 'Trash collection is not provided') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/doris-creek-campground ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is not available at this site.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'Seasons of Use: Mid May - September'.

Run in summer by concessionaire Flathead Valley Campgrounds. 5 sites reservable on recreation.gov, 4 first-come walk-up sites. Reserved sites are held until 11 a.m. the day after arrival; reservation holders may not move to a walk-up site. 16 consecutive days, 32 nights a year. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 11 am.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234788 (overview, notices, maxConsecutiveStay 16, maxStay 32 nights each year) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/doris-creek-campground ('managed by a concessionaire, Flathead Valley Campgrounds, during the summer months'), read 2026-10-22

note: Flathead National Forest campground on the west side of Hungry Horse Reservoir, ~14 mi SW of Glacier's West Glacier entrance; concrete boat ramp within the campground, host at the Doris boat launch. --Claude
summary: recreation.gov + Forest Service: confirmed 9 sites (5 reservable, 4 walk-up), vault toilet, no water, recreation.gov booking with FCFS sites, $18/night (2026 rate table; the FS page's $16 is from April 2025, fees left). Added season mid May - September, 16-day limit, concessionaire Flathead Valley Campgrounds. No rig lengths or discounts stated. Note trimmed of restated values.
